caption: Table 53-3. Kibble size comparison of selected large-kibble dry commercial foods to consider for feeding medium-, large- and giant-breed dogs to reduce the risk of gastric dilatation and volvulus.*
rows:
>30 mm for giant-breed dogs
Somewhat smaller kibbles (<30 mm) may be effective in medium- and large-breed dogs as long as the kibble is sufficiently large to prevent rapid eating
